description: Flashloans Arbitrage Bot Dapp:  https://trustwallet-flashloan.web.app   Open the bot with the link above, works with metamask & trustwallet browser (mobile)  So what are flash loans all about? And how can they be used to borrow millions of dollars worth of crypto with no collateral? But more importantly... How can I make a lot of money from this? You'll find answers to these questions in this video.  How it works?  1) Trust Wallet FlashBot will automatically check for possible arbitrage opportunity for the selected token on the Decentralized exchanges (ETH or BSC chain)  2) Once the opportunity has been found, you can get a Flash Loan from AAVE, PancakeSwap/UniSwap or Multiplier-Finance (thanks to Trust Wallet flash swap). Flash loans are useful building blocks in DeFi as they can be used for things like arbitrage, swapping collateral and self-liquidation.  #BSC #BNB #FLASHLOAN #FLASH-LOAN-ARBITRAGE #Ethereum #ETH #cryptocurrency  Note: Binance Smart Chain was used as an example in the video, but it also works perfectly fine on Ethereum Mainnet;  Open the link below in your Trust Wallet Dapp browser.  For desktop users, Install Metamask on your browser then open the link.   hashtags: flash laon,flash loan arbitage,arbitrage bot,uniswap flash loan,trust wallet flash loan,flash loan arbitrage bot
